build: Both GNU/Linux release binaries were built from source.tar plus stdio-readiness.patch, in the same isolated source and target directories. Only crates/pvisor-overlay-core/src/core.rs was replaced between builds. The separately captured source.patch was not applied.
scope: Both include the same guest stdio readiness fix. Baseline core restores the resolver before unavailable-upper marker optimization; candidate core is the optimized resolver. Both use archived statx implementation.
